headline: European Natural Gas Prices Decline on Potential Iran Deal
summary: European natural gas prices at the Dutch Title Transfer Facility fell by 2% following U.S. election results. Market participants are optimistic that a resolution to the Iran conflict could restore LNG flows through the Strait of Hormuz.
why: The Dutch Title Transfer Facility (TTF) is the primary benchmark for European natural gas pricing. Geopolitical developments in major energy-producing regions directly influence global supply expectations and commodity prices.

impacts.name: European natural gas
impacts.why: Expectations of increased supply through the Strait of Hormuz reduce the risk premium on European gas prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Commodity markets react to geopolitical news that signals potential changes in supply chain stability, particularly regarding critical energy transit routes like the Strait of Hormuz.
